src.sql: IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 PSU.[State] FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates] AS PSU INNER JOIN {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes] AS PH ON PH.ProductID = PSU.Product WHERE PSU.[State] = 'Critical' AND PSU.Product = '[TknParams:ProductID]' AND PSU.Version > PH.InstalledVersion ) BEGIN SELECT 'Critical' END ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 PSU.[State] FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates] AS PSU INNER JOIN {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes] AS PH ON PH.ProductID = PSU.Product WHERE PSU.[State] = 'Recommended' AND PSU.Product = '[TknParams:ProductID]' AND PSU.Version > PH.InstalledVersion ) BEGIN SELECT 'Recommended' END ELSE BEGIN SELECT [State] FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes] WHERE Id = '[TknParams:HotfixID]' END
